channel.title: Hack the Platform Blog
channel.description: Insights, tutorials, and stories about Microsoft Power Platform and beyond. Empower your business with Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Agents, and more.

item.title: Converting CSV to JSON in Power Platform
item.description: Unlock the potential of your data with our comprehensive guide on converting CSV files to JSON format using Power Platform. Learn step-by-step processes, tips, and tricks to seamlessly transform your data for enhanced analysis and integration. Dive into the power of Power Platform and elevate your data handling skills today!
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 1 - Choice Column with Single Value
item.description: Learn how to work with single-value Choice columns in Dataverse and configure them with Dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 4 - LookUp Column with Multiple Values (Many-to-Many Relationships)
item.description: How to handle many-to-many relationships in Dataverse using Dataflows, with a detailed comparison of manual vs built-in approaches.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 3 - LookUp Column with Single Value
item.description: In Part 3 of the Dataflows series, we focus on working with Dataverse Lookup Columns (Single Values) and how to prepare, map, and validate them in Power Platform dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 2 - Choice Column with Multiple Values
item.description: Learn how to handle multi-select Choice columns from SharePoint and map them into Dataverse using Power Query dataflows. This post walks through creating a custom lookup table, expanding and merging multiple values, and grouping them back into a format that Dataverse can store. Includes step-by-step guidance and Power Query code snippets.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Custom Connector for Power Automate Approvals
item.description: Learn how to build a reusable Custom Connector for Power Automate Approvals and integrate it into Power Apps.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: How to delete connections from the environment
item.description: Cleaning up **shared_logicflows** connections in error state is essential for maintaining a healthy Power Platform environment. By following the steps outlined in this blog post, you’ll keep your connections tidy and improve overall performance.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
